verdict.rationale: pnpm is a package manager that runs on demand from the CLI. Setting up autonomous background automations is a capability of agent or automation platforms, not of this product category. Nothing in the evidence shows pnpm shipping any scheduler, background runner, or autonomous automation feature that would make the axis apply. CI auto-detection (frozen-lockfile mode) and `audit --fix` are one-off behaviours inside a command the user invokes, not background automations.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
